# @wrightkit/wright-win32-x64

Native binary package of [Wright](https://github.com/wrightkit/wright) for Windows x64 (`win32-x64`).

This is a platform-specific distribution package consumed by [`@wrightkit/wright`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wrightkit/wright). Users and downstream tools should generally depend on and install `@wrightkit/wright` directly.
